name: Amaroq Minerals Ltd.
summary: Amaroq Minerals Ltd. is dedicated to the procurement, exploration, and subsequent development of mineral resources throughout Greenland. Focusing specifically on South Greenland, the company's operations involve identifying diverse valuable minerals, including gold, copper, molybdenum, graphite, platinum group elements, nickel, and rare earth elements. It possesses rights to eleven distinct exploration licenses, such as Nalunaq, Vagar, Tartog, Nuna Nutaaq, Anoritooq, Siku, Saarloq, North Sava, Sava, Stendalen, Kobbermineburgt, Paatasoq West, and Nunarsuit, collectively covering an expansive 7,615.85 square kilometers. The entity, which previously operated as AEX Gold Inc., officially rebranded to Amaroq Minerals Ltd. in July 2022. Established in 2017, Amaroq Minerals Ltd. has its primary corporate office located in Toronto, Canada.
